title: Advisor Archetype Rules
description: Canonical rule table consumed by the complexity advisor's diagnosis engine (ADR-0.0.29 / OBPI-0.0.29-02). Each rule binds a refactor archetype, a metric/band predicate, and an AST-shape predicate to a doctrinal frame. The rule table is doctrine, not configuration; amendments flow through the doctrine-amendment-protocol pool stub forward-referenced from ADR-0.0.27. The engine evaluates rules in declared order; the first matching rule wins. When no rule matches, the engine falls back to RefactorArchetype.LONG_PARAMETER_LIST and the per-metric doctrinal frame parsed from the cited distilled-characteristics document.

RefactorArchetype.description: One of the ten canonical refactor archetypes. Mirrors gzkit.complexity.advisor.diagnosis.RefactorArchetype.

metrics.description: Non-empty list of metric keys this rule applies to (e.g. 'lizard_param_count').

bands.description: Non-empty list of trigger-semantic bands this rule applies to.

node_kind.description: AST node-class name the rule matches against.

min_param_count.description: Minimum number of positional/keyword parameters for FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef matches.

min_branch_count.description: Minimum number of nested control-flow nodes (If/For/While/Match) under the target node.

min_argument_count.description: Minimum number of arguments at a Call site.

min_class_attributes.description: Minimum number of class-level attribute assignments under a ClassDef.

min_method_calls.description: Minimum number of Call nodes inside the target function (rough cohesion proxy).

authority.description: One of the four canonical doctrinal authorities (mirrors DoctrinalFrame.authority Literal).

citation.description: Free-form citation string (book title, chapter, page).

excerpt.description: Brief excerpt (paraphrase preferred; primary-source authorial voice avoided to minimize licensing concerns).
